description: 236-player 2026 Uzbekistan Super League squad catalogue. Player identity, club, age, position and market value are sourced from Transfermarkt squad pages where captured; game OVR is an approximate ZAMIN FK estimate, not an official EA FC rating.

ratingMethod.sourceData: Transfermarkt 2026 club squad pages provide roster identity, age, position and market value where captured. The original 68 retain the existing PFL-based club/DOB records and ZAMIN FK balancing OVRs.
ratingMethod.estimatedOVR: ZAMIN FK game OVR is an approximation using market-value bands and age for added players; existing seed ratings are retained for the original 68. No values are presented as official EA FC/FIFA ratings.
ratingMethod.limitations: Some players have only an age, not an exact DOB. Those DOB fields are null. The catalogue is a 236-player research snapshot, not the full 393-player league registration list.
